notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are PDF reports (Precinct Results Report / Cumulative Results Report, Microsoft Reporting Services) listed on the county's Election Archives page. 2024 general: 'Final Cumulative Results' (run 9:51 PM 11/05/2024, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 04:30:35 GMT = 10:30 PM CST) is county totals; the 'Precinct Results' report was run 8:29 AM 11/06/2024 (file name '11-6-2024 08-30-08 AM'; current Last-Modified Tue, 12 Nov 2024 14:51:33 GMT), after election night. 2026 primary: 'Precinct by Precinct Results' (file 20260309_Precinct Results.pdf) is headed 'Election day + E.V.', run 9:53 PM 03/03/2026, with Absentee, Early and Election Day columns per precinct, Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 04:11:50 GMT (10:11 PM CST election night); only one election-night precinct report is listed. 2026 runoff: 'Run-Off Election Results' cumulative report run 8:11 PM 05/26/2026 but Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 17:28:43 GMT (next day); 'Precinct by Precinct Results' run 10:56 AM 05/28/2026, Last-Modified Thu, 28 May 2026 22:12:05 GMT. Server Last-Modified values differ per file, so they are real upload times, though a replaced file hides an earlier upload. Check 3 pending (origin/wayback-data not present).
